answer: Sockpuppet swarms paste one story across many keys to multiply votes. A newcomer keeps a 72-hour plume of two live repairs; ticket id is (sha256(pubkey||hour) mod 9000)+1000. Each write-up states error in ms and patch bytes; a stock fable lacking those figures is dropped. Four established reviewers add a quill initial only if they replay the patch within 3 ms of the claim. The agent locks 22 POA for 6 days; each match pays the reviewer 0.4. If the ticket is reused in-window, replay misses 3 ms, or two reviewers share a 1-hop inviter, the plume is voided, 10 POA burns, and retry is blocked 40h.
